main_text.p: tant, quo Musæ, quæ consilio non possunt, impetu sistantur ac præclara ingenia, si quæ restant, spe præmiorum excitata, in illis velut seminariis ad meliora tempora & ad posteritatem conservconventur.

page.notes: The running head is "DEDICATIO:" in small capitals. The line "*5 stri" at the foot is a signature-like mark followed by the start of a word; it is transcribed as printed. The first paragraph's end ("conservconventur") shows a line-end hyphenation "conser-/ventur" and is given as printed where the hyphen is at line end; the last line reads "Accessit & alterum summi Ve-stri" with the word broken across the line and continued as "stri".
